how_to_apply: Interested and eligible candidates can apply for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026 through online mode only, on or before 14-10-2026. Follow the steps below:
Visit the IFFCO careers portal link: https://careers.iffco-recruitments.in/jobs/agriculture-graduate-trainee-2026.
Read the advertisement carefully and make sure you meet the educational qualification, minimum marks and age limit.
Fill in the online application form with correct details. If you have a CGPA score, convert it into percentage while filling in the form.
Select the State for which you are applying, as you must be well versed in the regional language of that State.
Submit the application on or before 14-10-2026 and keep a copy for your records.
Arrange a computer/laptop with internet facility for the Preliminary Online Test, which is taken in an open environment using your own resources.
Any application sent through any other mode will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026 should meet the following educational and language requirements. Educational Qualification: Four-year B.Sc. (Agriculture) full-time regular degree from a University/Institute recognized by the UGC/AICTE. Minimum Marks (General/OBC): Minimum aggregate of 60% marks in the B.Sc. (Agriculture) degree. Minimum Marks (SC/ST): Minimum aggregate of 55% marks in the B.Sc. (Agriculture) degree. Candidates who have a CGPA score must convert it into percentage while filling in the application form. Language: Candidates must be well versed in reading, writing and speaking the regional language of the State for which the application is made. Knowing one or more languages will be an added advantage, and knowledge of Hindi is desirable. Training Period: Selected candidates will undergo a training period of one year.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post available under IFFCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: IFFCO has invited online applications for the post of Agriculture Graduate Trainee (AGT).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 14 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a four-year full-time regular B.Sc. (Agriculture) degree from a UGC/AICTE-recognized University or Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What minimum marks are required for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General/OBC candidates need at least 60% aggregate marks, while SC/ST candidates need at least 55% aggregate marks in B.Sc. (Agriculture).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IFFCO Agriculture Graduate Trainee Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 30 years as on 01 September 2026. Age relaxation is applicable for eligible SC/ST and OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend during IFFCO AGT training?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a stipend of Rs. 33,300 per month during the one-year training period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary after completing IFFCO AGT training?
faq.answer: On successful completion of training and subject to IFFCO's requirement, AGTs may be absorbed at a basic pay of Rs. 37,000 per month in the pay scale of Rs. 37,000–70,000.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for IFFCO AGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Preliminary Online Test, Final Online Test, Personal Interview and Medical Examination.
